conclusion: the P0 reference integer-tick schedule is an admissible FPPS theorem-model schedule
exact_statement: Every P0 reference schedule whose time points are integer ticks, whose processor overhead is zero, whose execution is fully preemptive, and whose dispatch rule is work-conserving strict fixed priority is an instance of the single-processor FPPS theorem model with the same task parameters and priority order. This theorem establishes only model embedding; it does not establish a concrete-prefix refinement.
source_reference: This framework theorem interface, P0 discrete-tick embedding
